description: Machine-readable level labels for a format-1 market index. A label is a claim with a scope; it is not a certification and the host does not verify it.

entry.note: no committed result carries the 0.2.2-rc.3 anchor yet (asOf 2026-11-14); a runtime label needs a report whose anchor.dsh is 0.2.2-rc.3

rules: A label must carry a status, a scope (dsh/cordis versions), and an evidence link or an explicit not-run/not-measured.
Never emit both dsh-entry:runtime and dsh-boost:measured without separate evidence.
Never turn a certification grade A-D into dsh-entry:* or dsh-flow:*.
Stale evidence must be relabeled stale or removed; do not keep a PASS label.
